arxiv-2012-04478.title: Escape dynamics of active particles in multistable potentials
arxiv-2012-04478.creator: A. Militaru, M. Innerbichler, M. Frimmer, F. Tebbenjohanns, L. Novotny, C. Dellago
arxiv-2012-04478.description: Abstract Rare transitions between long-lived metastable states underlie a great variety of physical, chemical and biological processes. Our quantitative understanding of reactive mechanisms has been driven forward by the insights of transition state theory. In particular, the dynamic framework developed by Kramers marks an outstanding milestone for the field.

arxiv-2012-11069.title: Anosov-Katok constructions for quasi-periodic SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℝ ) \mathrm{SL}(2,{\mathbb{R}}) cocycles
arxiv-2012-11069.creator: Nikolaos Karaliolios, Xu Xu, Qi Zhou
arxiv-2012-11069.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Nikolaos Karaliolios, Xu Xu, Qi Zhou. We prove that if the frequency of the quasi-periodic SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℝ ) \mathrm{SL}(2,{\mathbb{R}}) cocycle is Diophantine, then the following properties are dense in the subcritical regime: for any 1 2 < κ < 1 \frac{1}{2}<\kappa<1 , the Lyapunov exponent is exactly κ \kappa -Hölder continuous; the extended eigenstates of the potential have optimal sub-linear growth; and the dual operator associated a subcritical potential has power-law decay eigenfunctions.

arxiv-2202-05458.title: Conditional Contrastive Learning with Kernel
arxiv-2202-05458.creator: Yao-Hung Hubert Tsai, Tianqin Li, Martin Q. Ma, Han Zhao, Kun Zhang, Louis-Philippe Morency, & Ruslan Salakhutdinov
arxiv-2202-05458.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yao-Hung Hubert Tsai, Tianqin Li, Martin Q. Ma, Han Zhao, Kun Zhang, Louis-Philippe Morency, & Ruslan Salakhutdinov. Conditional contrastive learning frameworks consider the conditional sampling procedure that constructs positive or negative data pairs conditioned on specific variables.

arxiv-2307-01384.title: Systematic Bias in Sample Inference and its Effect on Machine Learning
arxiv-2307-01384.creator: Owen O’Neill, Fintan Costello
arxiv-2307-01384.description: Abstract A commonly observed pattern in machine learning models is an underprediction of the target feature, with the model’s predicted target rate for members of a given category typically being lower than the actual target rate for members of that category in the training set.

arxiv-2308-13281.title: A note on joint calibration estimators for totals and quantiles
arxiv-2308-13281.creator: Maciej Beręsewicz, Marcin Szymkowiak
arxiv-2308-13281.description: Abstract In this paper, we combine calibration for population totals proposed by Deville & Särndal 1992 with calibration for population quantiles introduced by Harms & Duchesne 2006 . We also extend the pseudo-empirical likelihood method proposed by Chen et al. 2002 .

arxiv-2502-18576.title: Investigating Youth AI Auditing
arxiv-2502-18576.creator: Jaemarie Solyst, Cindy Peng, Wesley Hanwen Deng, Praneetha Pratapa, Amy Ogan, Jessica Hammer, Jason Hong, Motahhare Eslami
arxiv-2502-18576.description: Abstract . Youth are active users and stakeholders of artificial intelligence (AI), yet they are often not included in responsible AI (RAI) practices. Emerging efforts in RAI largely focus on adult populations, missing an opportunity to get unique perspectives of youth.

arxiv-2511-10433.title: Routes to the density profile and structural inconsistency
arxiv-2511-10433.creator: S. M. Tschopp, H. Vahid, J. M. Brader
arxiv-2511-10433.description: Abstract Classical density functional theory (DFT) is the primary method for investigations of inhomogeneous fluids in external fields. It requires the excess Helmholtz free energy functional as input to an Euler-Lagrange equation for the one-body density. A variant of this methodology, the force-DFT, uses instead the Yvon-Born-Green equation to generate density profiles.

arxiv-2511-12981.title: The Grain Family of Stream Ciphers: an Abstraction, Strengthening of Components and New Concrete Instantiations
arxiv-2511-12981.creator: Palash Sarkar
arxiv-2511-12981.description: Abstract The first contribution of the paper is to put forward an abstract definition of the Grain family of stream ciphers which formalises the different components that are required to specify a particular member of the family. Our second contribution is to provide new and strengthened definitions of the components.

pmc-11685053.title: Use of computed tomography to determine body surface area and K ‐constant in Atlantic Stingrays for chemotherapeutic dosing
pmc-11685053.creator: Laura Martinelli, Nathan Nelson, Elizabeth Duke, Emily F. Christiansen, Lori S. Westmoreland, Craig A. Harms, Tara M. Harrison
pmc-11685053.description: ObjectiveThe objective of this study was to use body surface area (BSA) obtained via computed tomography (CT) to calculate a species‐specific shape constant (K) and provide a formula for BSA based on body weight (BW) in Atlantic Stingrays Hypanus sabina. Ultimately, this information can be used to more accurately calculate chemotherapeutic doses and other metabolic‐related measures.

pmc-12537403.title: Predictive value of serum uric acid-to-albumin ratio for diabetic kidney disease in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a case-control study
pmc-12537403.creator: Jing Du, Xiumei Xu, Ning Yuan, Xiaomei Zhang
pmc-12537403.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this study was to investigate the predictive effects of the serum uric acid-to-albumin ratio (sUAR) on the onset of diabetic kidney disease (DKD) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).MethodsA case-control study was conducted involving 1809 patients with T2DM, including 486 cases with DKD and 1323 cases without DKD.

pmc-12560102.title: Comprehensive Care for Wildfire Survivors in Los Angeles, 2025
pmc-12560102.creator: Kojima N.
pmc-12560102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). From January 7 to 31, 2025, Los Angeles experienced a series of destructive wildfires. This is a representative narrative short report of patients who were affected by the wildfires and the services they requested. This short report was written to provide narratives of patients who were affected by the natural disaster, details of hardships faced in its aftermath, a summary of services that were available through local disaster centers, and insights for future natural disaster preparedness planning efforts.
